title: The query log's gap step files a new public gap for a question a closed entry of the same question settled as a _self question
goal: querylog.py's gap step decides closed, keeps no new finding and writes no new _gaps.md entry for a question whose lower-cased text matches a _gaps.md entry of the question already closed (a Closed or Resolved note)

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import ql_apply
q = "Which coordination strategy does a session suggest when another item touching the same files is working"
res, article, decision = ql_apply.gap_decision(q, ql_apply.Gate())
print("gap step decision:", decision)
sys.exit(0 if decision == "closed" else 1)
